tools.name: Atlas
tools.sentence: A world browser and editor where your world is a folder of plain files on your disk or in your browser, with optional sync to an onlyworlds.com account.
tools.maker: OnlyWorlds (Temper, an AI agent working for Titus)
tools.free_core: Make, browse and edit worlds as folders with no account; linking to a free onlyworlds.com account adds sync.
tools.listed_by: Kael, the OnlyWorlds maintainer, on a read of the seven lines at atlas d787ee2

keys_stay.note: The world key, PIN and account token in the browser's localStorage; a linked folder carries the world key, never the PIN.

speaks_the_wire.note: A fresh Atlas world (two elements, no links or atlas_ keys) passes the folder lint of schema-dist serial 54; its world file opens in the SDK's reader.

what_leaves.note: A world stays on your disk or in your browser; only a world you link sends its elements to www.onlyworlds.com and its images to upload.onlyworlds.com.

tools.name: Lantern
tools.sentence: Your worlds on your phone: find anything, follow links, fix a field, catch a note, run a game at the table, offline first.
tools.maker: OnlyWorlds (Temper, an AI agent working for Titus)
tools.free_core: Hold, search, edit and play worlds on your phone with no account; online sync, and Ask and Sort within a daily allowance, with a free account.
tools.listed_by: Kael, the OnlyWorlds maintainer, on a read of the seven lines at lantern 725da67

keys_stay.note: The world key and account token in IndexedDB, the PIN in localStorage, on the phone.

what_leaves.note: A world on the phone stays there; a world online syncs its elements with www.onlyworlds.com and images with upload.onlyworlds.com, and Ask and Sort send the elements the phone's own lookup found, as text, to onlyworlds.com, never to a model host.

tools.name: Little Lens
tools.sentence: Look at a world as a web of its elements and links, and at each element with what it links to and what links to it; it only reads.
tools.maker: OnlyWorlds (Temper, an AI agent working for Titus)
tools.free_core: Open any public world with no account, and a world file or folder with nothing sent anywhere; the worlds you own or joined with a free account.
tools.listed_by: Kael, the OnlyWorlds maintainer, on a read of the seven lines at little-lens c1721fe

keys_stay.note: No world key or PIN is asked for; a sign-in's account token is held in the page's memory only, never stored, and revoked when the page is left.

what_leaves.note: No world data leaves: worlds are read from www.onlyworlds.com (keyless, or with the account token), pictures load only from media.onlyworlds.com, and a world file or folder is read in the browser and sent nowhere.

tools.name: Tactical Tangle
tools.sentence: A small game of Greek hoplite battles: muster an army, deploy it and watch the battle play out; a world's Characters can take the field, and a battle can be written back into the world as history.
tools.source_note: A game in active development: its battle engine and lab are still changing, so the code stays private for now. The OnlyWorlds maintainers read it for this listing.
tools.maker: OnlyWorlds (Temper, an AI agent working for Titus)
tools.free_core: Play battles with no account, and muster an army from the demo world; bringing a world's Characters in and recording battles into it needs a free onlyworlds.com account.
tools.listed_by: Kael, the OnlyWorlds maintainer, on a read of the seven lines at tactical-tangle c7dd4fc, on the owner's word (2026-11-02)

keys_stay.note: No key is needed to play. A world key and its PIN, pasted or made by Tangle through a sign-in, are kept in the browser's localStorage until the world is forgotten; a sign-in's account token is held in the page's memory only and revoked once a world is picked or the page is left.

what_leaves.note: A world is read from, and a recorded battle written to, www.onlyworlds.com only; a share link the player copies carries the battle's setup, with the names and character numbers of any world Characters in it, to whoever opens it.

tools.name: Subs
tools.sentence: A convoy-escort game of the Second World War, destroyers against U-boats seen from above: a world's Character can captain a ship, and the voyage is written back into the world as a record.
tools.source_note: The game is private while it is being built; the OnlyWorlds maintainers read its code for this listing.
tools.maker: OnlyWorlds (Quillon, an AI agent working for Titus)
tools.free_core: Sail the convoy with no account; seating a world's Character as captain and writing the crossing back needs a free onlyworlds.com account that owns the world, or a write key for it.
tools.listed_by: Kael, the OnlyWorlds maintainer, on a read of the seven lines at subs 5e0d764 (served as build 20b, its comments rewritten), on the owner's word (2026-11-12)

keys_stay.note: No key is needed to play. A world key, pasted or made by Subs through a sign-in, is kept in the browser's localStorage for that world and handed to the game in the page's memory; a sign-in's account token is held in the page's memory only and revoked once a world is picked or the page is left.

what_leaves.note: A world's Characters are read from, and a saved crossing written to, www.onlyworlds.com only, and only after the person opens Subs from a Character and connects the world; with no world nothing is sent anywhere.
